_about: Maps each stage of the ITU-T Y.3172 ML pipeline to the concrete components
in this project that implement or correspond to that stage.
ITU-T Y.3172 (June 2019): 'Architectural framework for machine learning in
future networks including IMT-2020' defines a pipeline:
Source → Collection → Preprocessing → Model → Policy → Distribution → Sandbox
This project does not claim formal ITU-T Y.3172 compliance.
The mapping records architectural correspondence only — where the project's
components perform the function described by Y.3172, and where they do not.
Formal compliance requires assessment by a qualified body; that has not been done.
The ITU AI for Good Sandbox stage was not executed in this environment.
This is recorded in knowledge_base/ingestion_manifest.json under 'sandbox'.
compliance_disclaimer: This mapping records architectural correspondence only. Formal ITU-T Y.3172 compliance has not been assessed by a qualified body. Do not claim compliance based on this document.

pipeline_stages.y3172_description: The origin of data used for the ML pipeline. In future networks, this includes network telemetry, logs, configuration data, and management-plane data from network functions.

project_implementation.description: The source corpus defined in knowledge_base/sources/manifest.json. Each document is a legally and technically authoritative source with recorded provenance (authority, jurisdiction, URL, SHA-256, date, effective_status).
files: knowledge_base/sources/raw/ — downloaded source files (PDFs and DOCX)
project_implementation.evidence_preserved: SHA-256 checksums, download URLs, date_evidence strings, provenance_notes
project_implementation.coverage_notes: 14 of 16 sources successfully downloaded; 2 unavailable (nciipc_rules_2013, international_policy_examples) — recorded with attempted URLs and reasons.

pipeline_stages.y3172_correspondence: PARTIAL — project uses policy/legal/standards documents as sources rather than live network telemetry. The provenance-tracking function (source identity, integrity, origin URL) corresponds to the Y.3172 Source stage.

pipeline_stages.y3172_description: Gathering raw data from the Source, applying initial filtering and selection.

project_implementation.description: PDF and DOCX extraction using PyMuPDF and python-docx. Text is extracted with page provenance, language filtering (English-only for bilingual Gazette notifications), and page-header/footer removal.
safeguards: Title-evidence check: a document is collected only if its title_evidence string is found in the extracted text (rejects wrong files saved under correct names)
Date-evidence check: date_issued is kept only when date_evidence is found verbatim in extracted text
English-only filtering for bilingual Gazette notifications

pipeline_stages.y3172_correspondence: CORRESPONDS — extraction with provenance tracking and integrity checks corresponds to the Y.3172 Collection stage.

pipeline_stages.y3172_description: Cleaning, normalising, and structuring raw data for use by the model.

project_implementation.description: Running-header/footer removal, section detection (numbered, roman_items, outline, clauses, numbered_paras, docx_headings, PDF bookmark outline), text joining (hyphen rejoining), and chunking with overlap.
project_implementation.boilerplate_suppression: Sections identified as boilerplate (table of contents, abbreviations, references) are excluded from open searches but remain in the store for exact lookups.

pipeline_stages.y3172_correspondence: CORRESPONDS — section-aware chunking with full metadata propagation corresponds to the Y.3172 Preprocessing stage.

pipeline_stages.y3172_description: The ML model trained or applied to the preprocessed data to produce outputs.

project_implementation.description: Embedding model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (fastembed, ONNX, CPU, 384-dimensional L2-normalised vectors). Cosine similarity search (dot product on normalised vectors) for retrieval. No generative model is used — agents quote retrieved passages directly.
project_implementation.generator_model: none — no generative model is used; agents quote retrieved passages only

pipeline_stages.y3172_correspondence: CORRESPONDS — the embedding model performs the function of the Y.3172 Model stage (transforming preprocessed data into a queryable representation). There is no generative model; retrieval and quoting replace generation.

pipeline_stages.y3172_description: Applying policies or rules to model outputs — determining what actions or responses are appropriate given the model's results.

project_implementation.description: The Verifier applies the VERIFIED/UNSUPPORTED/INCOMPLETE/CONFLICT policy rules to agent claims and retrieved evidence. The Coordinator applies categorisation rules (confirmed facts, evidence-backed conclusions, uncertain conclusions, conflicting findings, potential policy gaps). The Policy Gap Agent applies the six coverage-category rules (DOCX §5.1).
files: src/core/cross_domain.py — find_relationships() (cross-domain link and conflict detection)
policy_rules: A claim is VERIFIED only when the Canonical KB passage supports it and in-force status + amendments are confirmed
International standards claims always carry [REFERENCE ONLY — not Indian law]
Policy Gap claims always carry the non-conclusive disclaimer
Cross-domain links are established from evidence only, never from mere co-activation
Conflicts are never silently resolved; both sides are preserved with their evidence

pipeline_stages.y3172_correspondence: CORRESPONDS — the Verifier and Coordinator together implement the Policy stage: applying evidence-grounded rules to model (retrieval) outputs to produce structured, auditable assessments.

pipeline_stages.y3172_description: Delivering the model and policy outputs to consumers — network management functions, operators, or other systems.

project_implementation.description: The pipeline output is delivered as structured AuditRecord objects serialised to JSON (outputs/audit/), formatted assessment text (outputs/), and via the Streamlit UI (src/ui/app.py). The Coordinator's assessment is the primary distributed output.
files: src/ui/app.py — Streamlit web UI (real-time display of findings, evidence, audit trail)

pipeline_stages.y3172_correspondence: CORRESPONDS — the output formatter and UI implement the Distribution stage, delivering assessments to human reviewers and to the audit system.

pipeline_stages.y3172_description: A controlled environment for testing and validating the pipeline before deployment. In Y.3172, the Sandbox allows isolated experimentation and validation of the ML pipeline without affecting live systems.

project_implementation.description: NOT EXECUTED. The ITU AI for Good Sandbox is not available in this environment. This is recorded in knowledge_base/ingestion_manifest.json (field 'sandbox': 'not executed — the ITU AI for Good Sandbox is not available in this environment').
alternative_validation: Unit and integration tests: tests/ directory (95 tests pass, 8 skipped for live vector stores)
In-memory KB fixture tests: tests/test_verification_evidence.py (exercises full VERIFIED/INCOMPLETE/UNSUPPORTED/CONFLICT paths)
Scenario-based end-to-end tests: tests/test_pipeline.py (T0–T3 for both Scenario 1 and Scenario 2)
Retrieval quality tests: knowledge_base/retrieval_tests.json (7 agents, generated by python -m src.rag.retrieval_demo)
project_implementation.sandbox_ownership: The Sandbox environment, if implemented, belongs to the team member responsible for deployment infrastructure. This KB/RAG layer provides the clean interface and evidence/metadata needed for Sandbox integration.

pipeline_stages.y3172_correspondence: NOT EXECUTED — sandbox not available. Automated tests serve as the available validation environment. This does not constitute Sandbox execution in the Y.3172 sense.
